CoinShares: Latest CPI Print Not Particularly Helpful for Bitcoin CoinShares said the latest CPI print was not particularly helpful for Bitcoin. Headline inflation was broadly in line with expectations, while core inflation came in slightly above forecasts, raising the probability of a September rate hike and the risk that monetary policy remains restrictive for longer. With no dovish catalyst from CPI, Bitcoin’s near-term upside is likely to remain constrained, and a move above $80,000 may require weaker economic data, a more dovish Fed, or another policy catalyst. — link

Grayscale: Zcash Mining Rewards Are About 2x Bitcoin’s per Machine and 4x per MWh Grayscale said strong Zcash price performance has made ZEC mining highly profitable, encouraging more mining activity and strengthening network security. It estimates that a Zcash mining rig currently generates roughly twice the daily mining rewards of a Bitcoin miner and about four times as much revenue per megawatt-hour, although the hardware used to mine the two assets is not interchangeable. On a standardized hashpower basis, total Zcash mining activity has risen by more than 2.5x this year, creating a potentially reinforcing cycle in which higher token prices attract more miners, improve network security, and may in turn support the price. — link

Binance Research: Tokenized Stocks Shift From Issuance to Distribution and Usage Binance Research said the tokenized stock market is shifting from an issuance race to a competition over distribution and usage. Active tokenized stock market capitalization has risen 314% YTD to $4 billion, while monthly trading volume increased from $237 million in January to $7.9 billion in August and turnover rose from 0.23x to 2.14x. bStocks and Robinhood’s combined share of tracked issuer volume jumped from 0.8% in June to 82.3% in August and 87.8% so far in September. Active DeFi TVL for tokenized stocks also increased from $21.6 million to $289.1 million, rising from 2.2% to 7.2% of active market cap. Binance Research said issuance alone does not determine where liquidity flows; stronger platforms will be those that can convert users, retain liquidity after issuance, and give tokenized stocks additional on-chain utility. — link

Anthropic Seeks Up to $100 Billion in IPO at Around $2 Trillion Valuation; Nvidia Weighs Up to $10 Billion Investment Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia to bring the chipmaker in as an anchor investor for its planned IPO, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Anthropic is seeking to raise as much as $100 billion at a valuation of around $2 trillion, while Nvidia is considering investing up to $10 billion in the offering. The plans remain under discussion and could change. The listing is expected to be completed before the U.S. midterm elections in November. Anthropic raised $65 billion in May at a $965 billion post-money valuation, and its annualized revenue run rate exceeded $65 billion by the end of July. — link
